title: 第25章 炼狱炎蛛第26章 千丈仙王虚影重瞳之光斩通神
slug: 玄幻长生神子何须妹骨证道
content_zh:
虽然猜到是谁出手救了他们。
只不过真正看到这个身影的时候，顾紫玉和顾潇潇还是忍不住内心震动。
实在是这一幕很有冲击感。
毕竟顾长歌只是刚入命轮境，现在却为了她们，竟然硬撼通神境凶兽。
一时间，一种莫名的感觉充斥在两女内心。
毕竟她们本来就一直对这个镇压长生顾家年轻一辈的顾长歌很有好感，现在又看到顾长歌如同救世主一样站在眼前。
那种感觉。
她们芳心怎么可能没有波澜。
“嘶吼”
这只通神境凶兽，此时被顾长歌打断出手，生气咆哮。
本来她差一点就可以把这两个偷取自已守护机缘的蝼蚁吃掉了，结果顾长歌竟然横插一脚。
屹立在顾长歌面前的，乃是一头初入通神境的凶兽：炼狱炎蛛。
炼狱炎蛛全身布满鲜红如同血液一般的纹路，身躯巨大，有数丈高大，周身更是弥漫滚滚黑气，通神境气势浓烈，虚空气流都好似凝固了一样。
攻击手段能喷吐一口蕴含恐怖炎毒的火焰，除突破通神境之后，很有可能觉醒一门火系小神通。
炼狱炎蛛在凶兽当中十分普通，可步入通神境之后，觉醒神通，也是通神境之下的噩梦。
顾长歌静静打量炼狱炎蛛，他当然知道面前炼狱炎蛛什么来历。
“来吧，让我看看通神境的本事！”
顾长歌双手负于背后，淡淡道。
“吼！”
炼狱炎蛛嘶吼，巨大的身体一动，化作一道火红色流光。

刹那间冲到顾长歌面前，恐怖锋利的蛛腿像是一柄长刀，在虚空划过银光，狠狠斩击顾长歌。
顾长歌面色平静，一拳轰出。
体内气血咆哮，灵力包裹拳头，一拳轰出，一千五百斤巨力轰然爆发。
“咚”
拳头和蛛腿撞击。
一团可怕的气浪伴随着炸雷声，瞬间伴随着拳头蛛腿撞击扩散。
两方撞击，顾长歌身体一震，瞬间倒飞数十米，炼狱炎蛛身体轻轻一颤，微微倒退近十米。
“吼吼！”
炼狱炎蛛感知到自已被击退，顿时大怒，它堂堂通神境凶兽，竟然被一个比自已弱的蝼蚁击退了。
顾长歌看向炼狱炎蛛，饶有兴趣：“果然是普通凶兽，就算是踏入通神境，也不是不能对付。”
下方顾紫玉，顾潇潇还有顾景等人看到这一幕，瞳孔微微一缩。
顾长歌竟然能和通神境凶兽比拼肉身之力？
我的天？
他们看到了什么？
这是什么恐怖肉身实力。
要知道人族修士除了天生具备各大体质外，很少有人能和凶兽比拼肉身。
现在看到顾长歌竟以命轮境就可以用肉身硬撼炼狱炎蛛这个通神境凶兽？
嘶……他们没看错吧？
而且顾长歌天赋不应该是重瞳吗！
众人内心震撼。

不过，炼狱炎蛛因为顾长歌的话=，已经暴怒，对顾长歌继续攻击了。
“呼，滋滋滋！”
恐怖的火焰从炼狱炎蛛口中喷出，炽热让虚空扭曲。
甚至这口火焰喷出之后，虚空冒出滋滋的声音。
content_en:
Although I guess who saved them.
But when they actually saw this figure, Gu Ziyu and Gu Xiaoxiao couldn't help but feel shocked in their hearts.
This scene is really shocking.
After all, Gu Changge had just entered the Life Wheel Realm, but now for them, he actually defeated the ferocious beasts in the Divine Realm.
For a time, an inexplicable feeling filled the hearts of the two women.
After all, they had always had a good impression of Gu Changge, who suppressed the younger generation of the Changsheng Gu family, and now they saw Gu Changge standing in front of them like a savior.
That feeling.
How could there be no waves in their hearts.
"roar"
This ferocious beast in the realm of trance was interrupted by Gu Changge and roared angrily.
She was almost able to eat these two ants who stole her chance to protect her, but Gu Changge actually stepped in.
Standing in front of Gu Changge was a ferocious beast that had just entered the divine realm: the Purgatory Flame Spider.
The Purgatory Flame Spider's whole body is covered with bright red lines that look like blood. Its body is huge, several feet tall, and its whole body is filled with billowing black air. It has a strong aura in the realm of the gods, and the air flow seems to have solidified.
The attack method can spit out a mouthful of flames containing terrifying flames and poison. In addition to breaking through the realm of the gods, it is very likely to awaken a small magical power of the fire system.
The Purgatory Flame Spider is very common among ferocious beasts, but after entering the realm of divine connection and awakening magical powers, it is also a nightmare under the realm of divine connection.
Gu Changge looked at the Purgatory Flame Spider quietly. Of course he knew the origin of the Purgatory Flame Spider in front of him.
"Come on, let me see what I can do in the realm of gods!"
Gu Changge put his hands behind his back and said calmly.
"Roar!"
The Purgatory Flame Spider roared, and its huge body moved and turned into a stream of fiery red light.
In an instant, he rushed in front of Gu Changge. The terrifying and sharp spider legs were like a long knife, cutting through the silver light in the void and severely slashing Gu Changge.
Gu Changge looked calm and punched out.
The energy and blood in the body roared, the spiritual power wrapped around the fist, and with one punch, a huge force of 1,500 kilograms exploded.
"Boom"
Fists and spider legs clash.
A terrifying air wave was accompanied by the sound of thunder, and instantly spread with the impact of fists and spider legs.
When the two sides collided, Gu Changge's body was shaken and flew backwards for tens of meters in an instant. The Purgatory Flame Spider's body trembled slightly and retreated slightly for nearly ten meters.
"Ho ho ho!"
The Purgatory Flame Spider sensed that it had been repelled, and was immediately furious. It was a ferocious beast in the divine realm, but it was actually repelled by an ant that was weaker than itself.
Gu Changge looked at the Purgatory Flame Spider with great interest: "It is indeed an ordinary ferocious beast. Even if it enters the realm of divine connection, it is not impossible to deal with it."
When Gu Ziyu, Gu Xiaoxiao, Gu Jing and others below saw this scene, their pupils shrank slightly.
Gu Changge can actually compete with the ferocious beasts in the realm of trance in physical strength?
Oh My God?
What did they see?
What kind of terrifying physical strength is this.
You must know that apart from being born with various physical qualities, few human monks can physically compete with ferocious beasts.
Now I see that Gu Changge can actually use his physical body to defeat the vicious beast of the Divine Realm, the Purgatory Flame Spider, even though he is in the Life Wheel Realm?
Hiss...were they right?
And shouldn’t Gu Changge’s talent be double pupils?
Everyone was shocked.
However, the Purgatory Flame Spider became furious because of Gu Changge's words and continued to attack Gu Changge.
"Huh, sizzling!"
Terrifying flames spurted out from the mouth of the Purgatory Flame Spider, and the heat distorted the void.
Even after the flame was sprayed out, a sizzling sound emerged from the void.
